epic_goal: Eliminate critical bugs in CFN Loop coordination, implement comprehensive validation, and standardize parameter handling across all layers

background.investigation_trigger: Cross-team feedback request on race conditions, operation ordering, and parameter consistency
key_findings: Waiting mode not fully removed from agents (PATTERN-022 incomplete)
Gate pass signal lacks acknowledgment mechanism
Context injection has zero validation at any layer
false_alarms_clarified: Redis confidence collection race - FALSE (properly isolated with task-scoped keys)
Parallel swarm agent collision - LOW RISK (task-id namespacing works)
Validator spawn timing - CORRECT (sequential after gate check)

in_scope: Remove waiting mode from all agent completion protocols
Implement gate pass acknowledgment for Loop 2 validators
Add multi-layer context validation (Main Chat → Coordinator → Orchestrator → Agent)
Implement timeout validation (phase-id, max limits, negative checks)
Create context schema enforcement at all injection points
Add validation checkpoints to prevent 'consensus on vapor'
Update orchestrator to spawn specialized agents based on feedback type
out_of_scope: Redis pub/sub architecture changes (current design is correct)
Validator spawn timing changes (working as designed)
Confidence collection mechanism changes (atomic operations sufficient)
Agent registry system (low priority, task-id isolation sufficient)

phases.phase_name: Waiting Mode Removal & Agent Lifecycle Fix
phases.description: Complete PATTERN-022 implementation: remove waiting mode from agents, update orchestrator, enable adaptive agent specialization
deliverables: tests/test-agent-lifecycle.sh (verify agents exit cleanly after confidence report)
acceptance_criteria: Loop 3 agents exit immediately after reporting confidence
Loop 2 agents exit immediately after reporting confidence
No agents call invoke-waiting-mode.sh enter (except coordinators)
Orchestrator uses wait $PID successfully without indefinite blocking
Test suite validates clean agent exit across 3 iterations

phases.description: Add acknowledgment protocol for gate-passed signal to prevent validators from missing signal and ensure robust Loop 2 start
acceptance_criteria: Loop 2 validators send ACK after receiving gate-passed signal
Orchestrator waits for all validator ACKs before proceeding
Missing ACK triggers retry (max 3 attempts with 5s delay)
Failed ACK after retries logs error and continues (degraded mode)
Test validates ACK mechanism across 3 validators with 2s delays
phases.risk: Low - additive change, doesn't break existing flow

phases.description: Implement validation checkpoints at Main Chat, Coordinator, Orchestrator, and Agent layers to prevent 'consensus on vapor' and enforce context schema
acceptance_criteria: Schema enforces required fields: epicGoal, deliverables, directory, acceptanceCriteria, inScope, outOfScope
Coordinator validates context before storing in Redis
Orchestrator validates context before spawning agents
Agents receive and validate context contains deliverables list
Validation failures log error and request context clarification
Test validates rejection of minimal context ('Checkpoint 4.1')
Test validates acceptance of complete context with all required fields
phases.risk: High - critical for preventing consensus on vapor

phases.description: Standardize task-id generation (timestamp-based), agent-id generation (UUID-based), and add collision detection
acceptance_criteria: Task-id format: cfn-task-{unix-timestamp} (consistent across all spawns)
Agent-id format: {agent-type}-{uuid-prefix-8chars} (e.g., backend-dev-a1b2c3d4)
Collision detection checks Redis for existing agent-id before spawn
Parallel swarm test (2 simultaneous CFN loops) shows no collision
Test validates 100 sequential agent spawns have unique IDs
phases.risk: Low - changes ID generation only, doesn't affect coordination logic

phases.description: Add phase-id validation, maximum timeout limits, negative value checks, and enhance get-agent-timeout.sh
acceptance_criteria: Phase-id validated against known phases (phase-1, phase-2, phase-3, phase-4)
Unknown phase-id uses default timeout (60 minutes) and logs warning
Maximum timeout enforced (4 hours = 14400 seconds)
Negative timeout values rejected with error
Zero timeout rejected with error
Test validates all edge cases (negative, zero, too large, unknown phase)
phases.risk: Low - validation is additive, doesn't break existing timeouts

phases.description: Enable orchestrator to spawn different specialist agents for iteration N+1 based on feedback type (e.g., security-specialist for security issues)
acceptance_criteria: Feedback type 'security' spawns security-specialist instead of original coder
Feedback type 'performance' spawns performance-benchmarker
Feedback type 'architecture' spawns system-architect
Generic feedback spawns original Loop 3 agents
Test validates 4 different feedback types spawn correct specialists
Agent selection logged for debugging
phases.risk: Medium - requires feedback parsing and dynamic agent selection

functional: All agents exit cleanly after reporting confidence (no waiting mode blocking)
Loop 2 validators reliably receive gate-passed signal (ACK mechanism)
Zero 'consensus on vapor' incidents (context validation enforced)
Zero task-id or agent-id collisions in parallel swarm tests
All timeout edge cases handled correctly (validation enforced)
Adaptive agent specialization working for 4+ feedback types
quality: Comprehensive test coverage for all phases (>90% coverage)
All validation failures logged with actionable error messages
Documentation complete for all new skills and protocols
Zero regressions in existing CFN Loop functionality
performance: Gate ACK protocol adds <5s to Loop 2 start time
Context validation adds <50ms to coordinator spawn

integration_tests: Test complete CFN Loop with all fixes enabled
Test parallel swarm execution (2 simultaneous loops)
Test multi-iteration loop with adaptive specialization
regression_tests: Run existing CFN Loop test suite
Validate orchestrator test suite still passes
Test backward compatibility with old task-ids

rollback_strategy.phase_1: Revert orchestrate-cfn-loop.sh to restore waiting mode calls
rollback_strategy.phase_3: Disable context-validation skill calls in orchestrator
rollback_strategy.phase_4: Revert to original ID generation in orchestrate-cfn-loop.sh
rollback_strategy.phase_5: Remove validate-timeout.sh calls, use original get-agent-timeout.sh
rollback_strategy.phase_6: Disable adaptive spawn logic, use original agent lists

mitigation: Rollback plan validated before each phase
Parallel swarm testing in isolated environment

confirmed_bugs: Waiting mode still present in agents (PATTERN-022 incomplete)
Gate pass signal lacks acknowledgment (validators may miss signal)
Context validation completely absent (enables consensus on vapor)
Product Owner decision flow has no Redis blocking (parse-only, fragile)
false_alarms: Confidence collection race - Redis keys properly namespaced with task-id, atomic operations
Parallel swarm collision - Task-id isolation prevents cross-swarm interference
Validator spawn timing - Working correctly (sequential after gate check)
parameter_issues: Agent-id sequential numbering risky (should use UUIDs)
Context structure not validated (JSON schema needed)
Timeout validation incomplete (no phase-id check, no max limit)
architectural_strengths: Redis BLPOP for dependency ordering is solid
Sequential validator spawn after gate check is optimal design
Background process synchronization with wait $PID is correct
priority_recommendations: P0: Fix waiting mode removal (Phase 1) - blocks agent exit, prevents adaptive specialization
P0: Implement context validation (Phase 3) - prevents consensus on vapor
P1: Add gate ACK mechanism (Phase 2) - improves reliability
P2: Adaptive specialization (Phase 6) - enables advanced workflows
